answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy bonds each newcomer into a reef-indexed guild for 29 epochs before rewards unlock. Two random auditors replay every task; a failed replay burns 18 percent of the bond. A walnut sponsor quota admits only two fresh identities per epoch, and a thread fingerprint ledger quarantines accounts whose signed outputs move in lockstep. Seven clean rounds unlock payouts, so clones need capital and patience while task hashes keep the record verifiable.
